topic.title: Shadows
topic.shortdesc: Add or remove shadows to elements with box-shadow utilities. The shadow attribute enables standard Bootstrap shadow effects on a wide variety of DITA components.

section.title: Shadow Utilities
section.p: Bootstrap provides utilities for adding depth with text-bg colors and box-shadows. The shadow attribute can be set to yes, sm, lg or none.
Note that when a shadow is applied without an explicit margin, a default margin of 3 is automatically added to prevent the shadow from being clipped by the parent container.
